## Episode Thesis

This Börslunch episode (EFN, 21 Sep 2026) is about AI and automated investing, with guests from robo-advisor Lysa and an unlisted-equity analytics platform. They argue that AI will make markets more efficient and favour challengers with AI-native business models over incumbents. They also warn that herd behaviour could grow if everyone uses the same models, and say generating alpha will still need human creativity, with unlisted companies becoming more important as public markets move towards passive investing. The market view is optimistic long term but uncertain short term (AI bubble worries, high long-term rates), with news flow covering Anthropic's delayed IPO, Nscale's IPO filing, Truecaller's drop on Indian regulation and Novo Nordisk's weak capital markets day.
